items.markdown:
The **Away The Bigger Carry-On** is `a fan-favorite, slightly-maximized spin on the brand's classic hard-shell suitcase` . It is engineered to squeeze every last drop of packing capacity into a footprint that still clears most major U.S. airline overhead bins.[[1]](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:10663098522905436035,catalogid:3568033607959133490,gpcid:17208662549821919231,mid:576462498074601896&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)

### **Key Specs & Dimensions** 

- **Exterior Dimensions:** 23" × 15.4" × 9.4"
- **Weight:** 7.9 lbs (empty)
- **Capacity:** 49 L (good for roughly 4 to 9 days of travel depending on how you pack)
- **Shell Material:** 100% durable, lightweight polycarbonate
- **Price:** Around $295 (featured frequently as a top pick by outlets like *The New York Times Wirecutter*)[[1]](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:10663098522905436035,catalogid:3568033607959133490,gpcid:17208662549821919231,mid:576462498074601896&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)

### **The Pros (What People Love)** 

- **Maximized Space:** It holds noticeably more than a standard carry-on without feeling cumbersome, often saving you from needing to check a medium bag for weeklong trips.[[1]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)
- **Interior Compression System:** The signature dual-sided compression pad lets you buckle down extra clothes, and the included mesh pockets and water-repellent laundry bag keep things hyper-organized.[[1]](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:10663098522905436035,catalogid:3568033607959133490,gpcid:17208662549821919231,mid:576462498074601896&ibp=oshop)
- **Glide & Maneuverability:** The 360-degree smooth-gliding wheels spin effortlessly through tight airport terminals, concourses, and uneven sidewalks.[[1]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)
- **Ejectable Battery (Optional/Removable):** Designed with a quick-release battery compartment to easily comply with airline regulations if required.[[1]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)
- **LifetimeCare™ Warranty:** Backed by Away’s generous warranty policy covering functional damage for life, plus a 100-day trial period.[[1]](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black)

### **The Cons (The Catch)** 

- **Size/Airline Limits:** While it fits overhead bins on most major domestic airlines (Delta, United, American), ultra-low-cost carriers (like Spirit or Frontier) or smaller regional commuter jets may force you to gate-check it.
- **Scuffs & Marks:** The light-colored or matte hard-shells can scuff or show black marks after getting tossed around in overhead bins (though most marks buff out easily with a magic eraser).
- **No Built-In Front Pockets:** As a pure hard-shell case, there's no quick-access exterior pocket for a laptop or passport once it's zipped shut.[[1]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:10663098522905436035,catalogid:3568033607959133490,gpcid:17208662549821919231,mid:576462498074601896&ibp=oshop)

### **Verdict: Is It Worth It?** 

If you tend to over-pack just a little, hate checking bags, and want a sleek, ultra-durable piece of luggage that rolls like a dream, the Bigger Carry-On is widely considered a top-tier investment . You can check out color options and availability directly on the [Away Official Store](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black).[[1]](https://allytravels.com/away-bigger-carry-on-review/)[[2]](https://www.awaytravel.com/products/bigger-carry-on-jet-black)
